title: zingy comforting croatian horseradish kadhai dish
description: a comforting and flavorful dish featuring the spicy kick of horseradish, served in a kadhai for a satisfying and low-glycemic-friendly meal
instructions: heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a kadhai over medium-high heat
add beef strips and cook until browned, about 5 minutes
remove the beef from the kadhai and set aside
add more oil if needed, then sauté the garlic, ginger, and onion until softened, about 3 minutes
add the horseradish and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly
add the bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes
add the tomatoes and stir to combine
return the beef to the kadhai and stir to coat with the sauce
season with salt and pepper to taste
serve hot and garnish with fresh herbs if desired
